description: Angular component for a scrollable grid with dynamic sizing, data fetching, and resize handling.

classes.name: ScrollGridComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a virtual scroll grid with customizable item sizes, columns, and data source.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes item size, buffer sizes, and data source.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets styles and observes resize if itemSize is a strategy.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Updates filter in data source when changed.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is an object.

methods.name: trackByItemsRow
methods.description: Tracks items by index for rendering optimization.

methods.name: trackByItem
methods.description: Tracks individual items for rendering optimization.

methods.name: updateItem
methods.description: Updates a specific item in data source.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Deletes an item from data source.

methods.name: onContentResize
methods.description: Recalculates item size based on container width.
